4a
Fire Command (A3a–d)
GENERAL FIRE TARGET PRIORITY
  1. Known Good Order target (not Concealed)
  2. Target in VPO Location
  3. Location with most Known targets (US#)
  4. Target in least TEM
  5. Most Good Order targets / most Weapons / most SMC
  6. If no Known target: fire at Concealed with same priorities
SW fires separately at target in least TEM; closest; most targets; combine with Inherent FP if necessary.
4b
Move Command (A4a–c)
MOVE NOTES
  • A4b (Advance): hex rosette toward FBE (west board edge)
  • Avoid FRIENDLY LOS/range where FFMO applies; use Assault Mvt or SMOKE
  • Infantry in Flame location: automatic Move command
  • Human Wave: automatic Move, no Panic (except leaders)
If movement impossible: consult A2 footnote for alternate action. Assault Movement assumed unless Advance Attitude with Double Time eligible.

1d6 — Random Die Roll
Case (b) — Woods/Brush Odd or Even Roll
One roll per mapboard determines whether S? are placed in woods/brush Locations with odd or even coordinates. Coordinate "0" counts as even.
Case (e) — Letter Chit Placement Roller
Rolls A6d → draws chits → rolls coordinate (d6+2) + radius (A6f) per chit per mapboard. No S? within 3 hexes of any whole off-board FBE hex (4.11).
Table A9e — Built-Up Map S? Placement (4.12)
Roll once per S? on a City or Village mapboard to determine building level. DRM −1 for Village.
S? Counter Setup — Mission Parameters (4.1)
Place S? Counters
4.1 — S? Placement Cases
Use a black-background S? for each initially placed counter. Max 2 S? per on-board Location [EXC: case e]. Refer to the Mission's "S? PLACEMENT/ENTRY" section for which case(s) apply.
(a) Buildings / Rubble / Lumberyards
One S? in each non-Rooftop/-Sewer building, rubble, or lumberyard Location [EXC: 4.11–.13].
(b) Woods / Brush
One S? in each woods/brush Location whose coordinate is odd or even (roll one dr per mapboard; "0" = even) AND that is either part of ≥ 3 connected woods/brush Locations, or is connected to the EBE edge where additional mapboards may be activated [EXC: 4.11–.13].
(c) VPO + Adjacent Concealment Terrain
One S? in each VPO Location (non-Rooftop/-Sewer; not on multi-hex bridge unless Accessible to a land hex) plus each Concealment Terrain Location adjacent to each VPO [EXC: 4.11–.13].
(d) VPO + Concealment Terrain within 2 Hexes
Same as (c), but place S? in each Concealment Terrain Location within two hexes of each VPO rather than only adjacent [EXC: 4.11–.13].
(e) Letter Chit / Placement Hex Method
For each mapboard:
1. Roll dr {A6d} → number of Letter Chits to draw. Each chit identifies a hexrow.
2. After drawing all chits, roll dr+2 (Final 3–8) per selected chit → coordinate → gives a "placement hex".
3. Roll dr {A6f} → radius (in hexes) from each placement hex.
4. Place one S? per eligible Concealment Terrain Location [EXC: 4.11–.13] within that radius (including the placement hex itself). Max one S? per Location by this method.
5. If ≤ 2 S? placed for a chit: remove them, draw a new chit, make a new placement dr.
6. Repeat for each remaining mapboard. Return all chits before next mapboard.
OG Location counts as Concealment Terrain if a theoretical LOF from the nearest off-board FBE hex would cross a wall/hedge/bocage hexside of that Location.
4.11 — Proximity to FBE: No S? may be initially set up within 3 hexes of any whole off-board hex along the FBE, regardless of placement case used.
4.12 — Built-Up Mapboards
Roll Table A9e for each building/rubble hex on a board with ≥ 19 buildings/rubble ("c" or "v" prefix on A9). Remove the S? if the rolled level doesn't exist in that hex [EXC: if hex contains ≥ 1 VPO Location, reroll until S? is in a VPO Location]. DRM −1 for Village mapboard.
Final drLevel Placement
0Ground + 1st Level
1Ground Level
21st Level
3None — remove S?
4All Levels †
52nd Level
6Ground + 2nd Level
† EXC: rooftop, sewer. Each rowhouse hex = separate building.
4.13 / 4.14 — Special Cases
4.13 Woods Mapboard ("w"): S? placed in a woods whole/half hex for cases b, c, d, or e stay on board only if a subsequent dr ≤ 3 (roll separately per S?) [EXC: no dr needed if in a VPO Location].

4.14 Depression / Crest Status: A S? in a Depression Location is placed in Crest status (B20.9) so its LOS toward the FBE crosses as many crest hexsides as possible.
Attitudes Quick Reference
Hold (3.31): S? never moves; fires on Activation.
Advance (3.32): S? advances in APh using hex rosette toward FBE (west). Activates when a FRIENDLY unit is in LOS.
Stacking (3.11): Before Activation, each S? counts as one squad.
Add S? Counter
Active S? Counters (0)
    Suspect Counter Rules
    Placement (4.1): On entry hexes per MSR. Each represents potential ENEMY unit(s).

    Activation (5.1): Roll dr (1d6). If dr ≤ AC# → Activated (roll A1). If dr > AC# → S? removed.

    Hold Attitude (3.31): S? never moves. Fires on Activation.

    Advance Attitude (3.32): S? advances in APh using hex rosette. Moves toward FBE (west). Activates when FRIENDLY unit in LOS.

    Long Range (5.32): S? ≥16 hex from FRIENDLY: auto-activates on dr=1 (1 squad+HMG); dr=3 → no AC, S? remains.

    Stacking (3.11): Before Activation, S? counts as one squad for stacking.
